summary: This bill appropriates $2,165,000,000 for fiscal year 2026 to the National Center for HIV, Viral Hepatitis, STD, and Tuberculosis Prevention of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention for its programs and activities.

scores.thoughts: This bill appropriates over $2 billion to the National Center for HIV, Viral Hepatitis, STD, and Tuberculosis Prevention. This funding directly supports public health initiatives for disease prevention and control, thus expanding public healthcare services.
